newsitem.title: USA: Deutsch, Cirasella depart Cambridge Partners.
newsitem.headline: Deutsch, Cirasella depart Cambridge Partners.

text.p: Cambridge Partners LLC and two of its municipal professionals have parted ways by mutual agreement, Donald Carey, a senior managing director at the firm said Thursday.

David Deutsch and Mike Cirasella left the firm on Tuesday, Carey said. Deutsch, a consultant in Cambridge's trading department who had been hired on a temporary basis, had been with the firm about three months, Carey said. Cirasella, a managing director in the firm's underwriting department, had been with Cambridge for about a year.

As a new firm, Cambridge is trying to find the right mix between its new issue marketing skills and its secondary market capabilities. The firm has been in business about a year-and-a-half, Carey said.
"And in trying to seek a balance we've decided that it didn't make sense to try to continue with those two individuals," he said.
While in time Cambridge may fill the vacancies left by Deutsch and Cirasella, it does not have any immediate hiring plans.
"We just think that because the market conditions are so difficult, we have to be patient," Carey said. "We don't want to grow too large in this market environment."
